dlg_rclone_info:
A terminal window (rclone config) will open.

1. Type  n  (new remote) and give it a name, e.g. gdrive
2. Choose your cloud service from the list
3. Press Enter on advanced prompts
4. Log in via the browser window that opens
5. Type  q  to quit and click 'Refresh list' here.
